race.comment: BARNEY ROMMEL (5) is the clear starting point after going under by only a head to Consolidated at Bunbury, and that effort had merit after he covered ground. His previous CL1 sixth was better than it reads, as he began slowly and still made solid inroads, so he arrives with the most reliable recent profile despite meeting harder company. GAV HAS SPOKEN (12) was plain in NMW1Y grade at Ascot last week, but her Kalgoorlie third to Just Sublime two back was a stronger pointer and the class drop keeps her right in the race. CAPABLE ANGEL (10) was safely held at Bunbury yet has a sound record at this track, and Fiore stays on board. Can run an improved race with the stable tinkering with her gear. GOLD BEAU (7) was beaten as favourite at York but gets the blinkers back on today and will carry no weight after the claim of Tsang. OLDEN (2) didn't handle the very quick turnaround last start but was in winning form prior. Can bounce back in a more suitable race today.
